e2e.// dependsOn: The server comes up under `serve-e2e`, not `serve`: that target name is what makes Nx load `apps/server/.env.serve-e2e`, the rate-limit profile of E61. Three e2e projects share one server process in a full run and therefore one set of throttle counters, and with the shipped numbers the project that ran last got 429 where it expected 202 (AP 8 of phase 4). The client is served by the ordinary `serve` — only the server has limits to configure.
